thread:
kevin: Heads up — planned rollout for v1.22 starts 02:00 UTC, canary group A first. tagging ops for monitoring.
sre_amy: seeing a correlated alert spike in control-plane at 01:52 UTC, not sure if related. raising a soft hold? :thinking_face:
deploy-bot: AUTOMATION: Release v1.22 scheduled. Current status: PENDING. Active holds: 0.
kevin: @sre_amy can you confirm severity? if it's a blip we can proceed with narrower canary.
sre_amy: spike is 503s hitting 0.6% across a subset of instances, trending up over the last 10m. i'd prefer a temporary hold until we get telemetry.
liam: +1 on hold. don't want to push a change window into an incident. what are rollback surface options if we unfreeze later?
anjali: quick note — the build includes the new kvcache kernel tweak. fallback plan is to pin to v1.21.4 which is hotfix-ready. rollback path: canary -> abort -> pin to v1.21.4 -> gradual resume.
sarah: release notes draft ready. if we hold we should still publish the notes internally so PM & support can prep. i'll push to the repo.
ops-oncall: holding the slot now. ran `/deploy hold 1769500000 reason="control-plane spike"` — deploy-bot should confirm. :pause_button:
deploy-bot: COMMAND ACK: `/deploy hold 1769500000` by ops-oncall. Status: HELD. Lock owner: ops-oncall. Suggested reschedule window: +3h or next day 02:00-04:00 UTC.
kevin: thanks. can we scope a short timeline: 30m diagnostics then decide?
sre_amy: working on logs and topologies, will have initial triage in ~20m. if spike stabilizes to <0.1% we can unhold and proceed with strict canary throttling.
liam: if we need to reschedule, prefer slot at 05:00 UTC rather than next day to keep momentum. ops thoughts?
ops-oncall: prefer +3h option (05:00 UTC). i'll tentatively reserve the slot and update calendar if we commit.
anjali: prepping the pin playbook now: commands + rollback checklist. copy of rollback steps:
```
# rollback (if canary fails)
/deploy abort --canary 1769500000
/deploy pin --version v1.21.4 --apply
/deploy resume --stagger 10%
```
kevin: perfect. once sres give thumbs we either unhold or we go with 05:00 UTC reschedule. update here in 20m.
sre_amy: 20m update: spike looks tied to control-plane config propagation; we see a bad config roll 01:40 UTC. mitigating now, error rate trending down. will re-check in 8m.
kevin: if it stays down we'll unhold and run a constrained canary (10% traffic). notify oncall when we unhold.
ops-oncall: noted. i'll stand by and remove lock when you say go.
kevin: thanks team. keeping thread for audit — i'll post final decision in 8m. :white_check_mark:
